global: This tonkotsu ramen features a creamy yellow, glossy broth with visible noodles and toppings. Served in a white ceramic bowl with black geometric pattern and Japanese text, it rests on a wooden table with a light brown grain pattern.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with subtle texture and natural wood finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black geometric pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings.
